steps.text: You haven't made any progress with it for months now. Even when I joined up with the rest of the team, we couldn't move forward at all.

steps.text: True. Admittedly, development in this area has been more difficult than I imagined.

steps.text: I've always had my suspicions, since from a data-perspective these kinds of results shouldn't be possible. But I never thought about it too much since I trusted you.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Until just now, when I checked the records of previous experiments and stumbled upon this...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Your sample report.

steps.name: Corroserum
steps.text: Was there some sort of problem with it?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Was there a problem?!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: In each batch of samples you make, you use less of the active ingredient than we calculated for.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: In other words, the samples we've been testing over the last few months have all been incomplete, defective products!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: No wonder the experimental results of your corrosive agents have been so disappointing. This whole time, we've barely met the minimum project design requirements.

steps.name: Corroserum
steps.text: Sorry, this does appear to be a major oversight on my part.

steps.name: Astgenne

steps.name: Corroserum

steps.name: Astgenne

steps.name: Corroserum

steps.name: Corroserum

steps.name: Corroserum
